Definition: tightness (i.e. figuratively, trouble); transitively, a female rival:
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tsârâh is the word for tightness, trouble; a rival. It appears 72 times in Scripture, including Genesis 35:3 and 1 Samuel 1:6.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsârâh is no accident in Scripture — God put it there on purpose.
